scope: Mount the already-built document view: a children slot in WorkspaceShell's main area, an app-level composition of DocumentViewer + HighlightedPage through renderPage, and a region-tool control. Out of scope: wiring the note sheet (012), presence cursors (015) or the import review (021) into the view; any new canvas/domain behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: WorkspaceShell's main area renders injected children when given, and its existing placeholder otherwise.
The app-level component imports @feature/document and @feature/highlight and uses no useAppSelector/useAppDispatch (I4); no feature imports another feature (I3).
Choosing 'rectangle' or 'freehand' arms the marquee with that tool; 'off' disarms it.
A test renders the composition with DocumentViewer/HighlightedPage mocked and asserts HighlightedPage receives the document page args and the armed tool.

open_questions: D-11 (defaulted: tablet authors, desktop analyses, mobile reads) — the toolbar is an authoring control; its mobile placement waits for 022.
Q8 (unanswered: the real tablet mix) — not needed for the wiring; the on-device frame check stays 009/011's follow-up.

NEW-1: this task is new (not in the 000-024 backlog); README Gate 1 says an ask no task covers becomes a new task with the next free NNN, added to 06 and given a plan doc first. It is filed as PHASE G — Integration. Recorded, not silently added.
risks: I3: composing document + highlight inside a feature would be a layering violation; the composition is kept at the app route.
I4: a store selector or dispatch under src/app is forbidden; the app component holds only the armed-tool useState.
The live gate (a seeded workspace in a browser) needs the local stack; the composition is proven with mocks instead, the live pass deferred like the other browser gates.
